A few words on Pluto, the one I posted as a "Robinhood MARS" play.

At the time, I saw it as a beta play on MARS — something that could ride along as MARS moved.

MARS has played out exactly the way I mapped it from the start, and I'm still holding a large position. Today it got its spot listing, which was the biggest trigger I'd been waiting for. I was happy — not just about the money, but about seeing a thesis play out the way I'd called it.

Riding that high, I looked at Pluto, thought "hm, not bad," bought some, and shared it without much thought.

Looking at it with a clear head now, it's not an alpha play.

Anything built on "this reminds me of X" can't be alpha by definition. If it evokes something, it's following a pattern that already exists — and something launched on the back of an existing pattern is a beta play. I do take beta plays from time to time, but I've never shared them here. They're small side bets I make for fun while watching the market, not something worth putting in front of all of you.

That's why I deleted the post. Leaving it up meant anyone coming across it later would just see my name on it and blind-ape in on trust alone. I didn't want that.

Today I was riding the mood and got careless. That's on me.

From here on, only alpha gets posted. Taking a short break until then.

Robinhood Chain / Lighter OI Points Farming

Another farming we’re currently running is OI points farming through the Lighter_xyz web interface on Robinhood Chain.

Using cross margin, we maintain a long/short basket designed to minimize directional exposure while adjusting individual positions as needed.

The strategy currently maintains gross OI at approximately 20x deposited capital.

Based on what we have directly observed so far, maintaining $1M in gross OI generates approximately:

• 0.22 Live Points per hour
• 5.3 Live Points per day
• 37 Live Points per week

Lighter has allocated a total of 11M LIT to the Robinhood community.

Assuming each point ultimately converts into approximately 7.33 LIT, the estimated gross APR at 20x gross OI relative to deposited capital would be:

•  LIT at $3 → ~85% APR
•  LIT at $4 → ~113% APR
•  LIT at $5 → ~141% APR

These estimates only include Live Points accrued in real time through the Lighter web interface. They do not include the additional Weekly Drop distributed every Friday.

One important detail is that trading on Lighter through Robinhood Wallet currently provides a 2x points multiplier. 

However, positions opened through that interface only support isolated margin.

For a strategy designed to maintain OI over longer periods, I personally believe that using cross margin through the web interface provides greater practical value than receiving 2x points under isolated margin.

Cross margin improves capital efficiency and provides more flexibility when managing liquidation risk across a hedged basket.

There are still several risks to consider:
•  Funding-rate differences between the long and short positions
•  Basis and beta mismatch within the hedge basket
•  A breakdown in correlation during volatile markets
•  Changes to the points formula or the eventual LIT conversion ratio
• Counterparty and protocol risk
•  Liquidation risk during sudden market moves

Once we have accumulated enough data on the Friday Weekly Drops, we will update the APR estimates to include that component as well.

For now, the figures above represent gross APR based solely on Live Points, before accounting for funding costs, directional PnL, and execution costs.

Kalshi에 이어 폴리마켓 역시 선물 거래 시장에 뛰어드네요.

Kalshi는 이미 BTC, ETH, SOL 등을 대상으로 Perps를 출시했고, 최근에는 주가지수, 금속, 외환, 금리뿐만 아니라 원유 Perps까지 영역을 확장하려 하고 있습니다. 폴리마켓도 이제 Perps를 붙이면서 예측마켓 플랫폼들이 단순히 특정 사건의 결과에 베팅하는 곳을 넘어, 사실상 “모든 것을 거래하는 플랫폼”으로 발전해 나가는 모습입니다.

동시에 제도권 안으로 들어가기 위한 움직임도 계속되고 있고요.

재밌는 건 트럼프 주니어인데, 트럼프 주니어는 경쟁사인 Kalshi의 전략 고문으로 활동해왔는데, 자신이 파트너로 있는 VC인 1789 Capital은 이번에 폴리마켓의 약 10억 달러 규모 투자 라운드를 리드했네요. 

미국에서는 이렇게 예측마켓이 점점 하나의 금융시장으로 자리 잡으려는 시도가 이어지고 있는 반면, 한국은 알다시피 도박이나 사행성에 굉장히 보수적이라 예측마켓 자체를 상당히 제한적으로 보고 있다는 점은 조금 아쉽습니다. 폴리마켓 같은 서비스가 한국에서도 충분히 나올 수 있는데 말이죠.

사실 따지고 보면 경계도 생각보다 애매합니다. “비트코인이 연말까지 20만 달러를 넘을 것인가?“에 돈을 거는 예측마켓과, 비트코인 옵션을 이용해 비슷한 방향성에 베팅하는 것은 경제적인 구조만 보면 그렇게 큰 차이가 없습니다. 금이나 주식 옵션 역시 미래의 가격을 예측하고, 그 결과에 따라 돈을 벌거나 잃는다는 점에서는 마찬가지고요.

물론 옵션에는 헤지와 리스크 이전이라는 중요한 기능이 있고 예측마켓과 완전히 동일하다고 볼 수는 없습니다. 하지만 그렇기 때문에 오히려 모든 예측시장을 단순히 “도박”이라는 틀 안에 넣고 막기보다는, 어떤 시장이 정보의 가격 발견이나 리스크 거래와 같은 경제적 기능을 하는지 구분해서 제도권 안에서 관리하는 방향이 더 맞지 않나 싶습니다. 미국에서 지금 벌어지고 있는 것도 결국 이 과정인 것 같아요.
